description: Plan and build a feature in small, tested steps

I want to build: ${input:feature:Describe the feature}

1. First, write a short plan (files to change, tests to add, risks). Wait for my approval before coding.
2. After approval, implement it following the relevant skills (api-endpoint, design-system, testing).
